title: Doing Audits Right? The Role of Sampling and Legal Content Analysis in Systemic Risk Assessments and Independent Audits in the Digital Services Act
reasoning: The paper focuses on the legal requirements and methodological approaches for auditing online platforms under the EU Digital Services Act. While it mentions systemic risks and human rights, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/moral frameworks outside of the context of legal compliance procedures.
